events.body:
## Context

`SETUP.md` is entirely about GitHub Pages and `.github/workflows/generate-repo-list.yml` (doesn't exist; the job is `.forkmesh/blt-owasp-bumper--generate-repo-list.yml`). README has GitHub badges, `cd OWASP-Bumper`, a "1s delay per 100 repos" claim the code doesn't do, stale line numbers, and "no secrets needed" contradicting `GH_API_TOKEN`.

## What to do

1. Replace SETUP.md with local run steps (`OUTPUT_FILE=public/index.html python3 generate_repo_list.py`) and pointers to the .forkmesh workflow and `scripts/refresh-kv.sh`.
2. Fix the README items above.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No GitHub Pages / `.github/workflows` mentions
- [ ] Clone/cd commands work
- [ ] No stale line numbers
- [ ] Rate-limit claims match the code

## How to test locally

```bash
Follow the README; scripts/ci/test.sh blt-owasp-bumper
```

---
Size: **S**. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
